artifact.title: Application Artifact Schema
artifact.description: Artifact Descriptor for Application Manager Installer

id.description: A Name-Version id for identifying this artifact

version.description: The version of an artifact (semantic version approach)
The concrete version of an artifact (semantic version) or the version range

optional.description: Indicates whether the dependency is optional

preRelease.description: Controls pre-release (e.g. SNAPSHOT) inclusion when resolving this dependency's version range: 'true' includes pre-release alongside stable, picking the overall highest match (default); 'false' resolves stable versions only; 'only' resolves pre-release versions only.

metadata.title: Metadata Schema
metadata.description: Metadata about creation and changes to records, provided by the server (client should not provide)

createdDate.description: Date and time when the record was created

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the record (when available)

modifiedDate.description: Date and time when the record was last updated

modifiedBy.description: ID of the user who last updated the record (when available)

version.description: A universally unique identifier (UUID), this is a 128-bit number used to identify a record and is shown in hex with dashes, for example 6312d172-f0cf-40f6-b27d-9fa8feaf332f; the UUID version must be from 1-5; see https://dev.folio.org/guides/uuids/
